title: Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been tested. We probe the pair representation at each of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding final C$_\alpha$-C$_\alpha$ distances with four probe families (a shared linear probe, per-protein linear probes, a sequence-separation-gated linear probe, and XGBoost) and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures from the decoded distances via multidimensional scaling. Across a cohort of 552 CAMEO and ECOD proteins, distance decodability ($R^2$) and reconstruction quality (TM-score) rise in early layers, plateau in the middle of the network, and rise again in late layers. translated_title: 匹配与校正：Evoformer层中一种重复出现的计算模式
translated_abstract: 三角注意力和三角乘法更新是Evoformer的关键组成部分，其被专门引入以促进与三角不等式的一致性。然而，各层之间的表征变化是否减少了三角不等式违反尚未得到检验。我们探测了OpenFold的48个Evoformer层中每一层的配对表征，使用四种探针族（共享线性探针、逐蛋白线性探针、序列间隔门控线性探针以及XGBoost）解码最终的Cα-Cα距离，并通过多维缩放从解码的距离重建中间3D结构。在由552个CAMEO和ECOD蛋白组成的队列上，距离可解码性（R²）和重建质量（TM-score）在早期层上升，在网络中部趋于平稳，并在后期层再次上升。直接测量解码距离中的三角不等式违反揭示了类似的、更为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次逐层探测OpenFold的48个Evoformer层，通过解码Cα-Cα距离并重建中间3D结构，检验三角注意力与三角乘法更新是否真正减少了三角不等式违反，发现距离可解码性与重建质量在网络中呈现“上升—平台—再上升”的模式。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first layer-by-layer probing of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding Cα-Cα distances and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures to directly test whether triangle attention and multiplicative updates reduce triangle inequality violations, revealing a rise-plateau-rise pattern in decodability and reconstruction quality across the network.
